name: Object of Love
source:
In a world where things that have strong emotions poured into them occasionally come to life and become humanoid creatures known as object-heads, a down-on-his-luck young man goes to ask his sister for a place to stay while he gets back on his feet... only to be told that she passed away not long ago, and that the bar she managed will have to close soon if they can't find someone willing to fill the now vacant position.

With little to no knowledge about the service industry, but having run out of options, he accepts. Will it turn out to be the opportunity he needed, or will it lead to disaster? Only one way to find out.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667370/Object_of_Love/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个充满强烈情感的事物偶尔会活起来并成为被称为“物体头”的人形生物的世界里，一个运气不佳的年轻人向他的妹妹寻求一个地方可以让他重新站起来……却被告知她不久前去世了，而她经营的酒吧如果找不到人愿意填补现在的空缺，就很快就要关门了。

由于对服务行业知之甚少甚至一无所知，但又别无选择，他接受了。这会是他需要的机会，还是会导致灾难？只有一种方法可以找出答案。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667370/Object_of_Love/]Steam[/url]]
